title: Top Gaming Monitors: 1440p to 4K (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in multiple reputable reviews (PCMag, PCWorld, RTINGS, Tom’s Hardware, TechRadar, Popular Mechanics, Club386).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no cost comparison is included.

verdict.line: Picture a gamer who wants deep blacks and fast response; the MSI MPG 271QR offers a QD‑OLED panel with 240 Hz refresh and variable‑refresh support, making it ideal for competitive play. Its main catch is the higher price point compared to other 1440p options.
